product_overview: The E-Budgeting System is a web application for managing corporate budgets and procurement submissions. It supports user access, budgeting dashboards, submission workflows, and administrative management for organizations.
core_goals: Sign in to access role-based budgeting features
View budget and submission statistics from a dashboard
Create and submit budget requests through the procurement workflow
Track the status of submitted requests
Manage users and departments as a superadmin

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Allows users to sign in and access the application based on their role.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email and password -> Submit the login form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter invalid email or password -> Submit the login form -> See an access error message

features.name: Dashboard Statistics
features.description: Shows an overview of key budgeting and activity metrics for authenticated users.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View total users, budget plans versus used budget, and active proposals

features.name: Budget Submission Flow
features.description: Lets authenticated users create and submit budget requests through the procurement process.
user_flows: Navigate to /pengajuan -> Create a PPBJ request -> Add a Proposal Harga -> Create an Internal Agreement -> Submit the budget request
Navigate to /pengajuan -> Start a budget submission with missing required information -> Attempt to continue the submission -> See validation feedback

features.name: Tracking & Monitoring
features.description: Allows users to check the current status and history of submitted requests.
user_flows: Navigate to /tracking -> View the status overview of active submissions -> Open a submission timeline -> Review approval history and timestamps

features.name: Superadmin Dashboard
features.description: Provides superadmin users with a high-level administrative overview of the system.
user_flows: Navigate to /superadmin -> View system-wide administrative dashboard metrics

features.name: User Management
features.description: Lets superadmin users manage employee accounts and role assignments.
user_flows: Navigate to /superadmin/users -> View the user list -> Add or update a user account -> Assign a role to the user

features.name: Department Management
features.description: Lets superadmin users configure organizational departments.
user_flows: Navigate to /superadmin/departments -> View the department list -> Create or update a department -> Save the department configuration

features.name: Dashboard Statistics
features.description: Overview of budget and user counts

features.name: Budget Submission Flow
features.description: Multi-step process to submit budget requests
